items.description: Added support for notification webhook URL in project settings.
Implemented self-update functionality for Orqy with a new update endpoint.
Enhanced deploy process to send outbound webhook notifications on completion.
Added check to prevent multiple concurrent deploys for the same project.
Updated frontend to include notification webhook URL input in AddProject and EditProject pages.
Included RefreshCw icon in Settings page for update functionality.
Integrated reqwest crate for HTTP client capabilities.
